result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try the command against a real folder.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is also in the no-argument usage overview, listed just before `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run()` sends both names to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method. In that method, `-help` prints the usage for the name the user typed, each with its own description.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line" section. It lists `init`, `generateReports`, `updateConfig`, `analyzeLandscape`, and `updateLandscape` (noted as the older name, kept for existing scripts).

I didn't edit `CLAUDE.md`, which still lists `updateLandscape` and doesn't mention the new name.
